data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,679k in the year, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business (2014: GBP 8,872k, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business.)
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 33.525m. During 2015 there was a gross prior-year release of GBP 5.243m (approximately 15.6% of opening gross claims outstanding), described as a positive run-off deviation predominantly in Accident & Health. The movement is reported in the claims outstanding reconciliation and attributed mainly to favourable claims development in Accident & Health.
raw_causal_phrases: positive run off deviation of GBP 3,679k in the year
predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business
positive run off deviation ... (2014: GBP 8,872k, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business.)
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the claims movement were taken from the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' line and the Claims Outstanding movement table (note 7). The prior-year movement used is the gross figure shown in the claims movement table (gross column). The report attributes the favourable run-off predominantly to Accident & Health but does not quantify the LOB-specific amount. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years are detailed. Claims development triangle is present and used for cross-checking.
